ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of low-intensity circular focal spots (mottling) across the high-intensity ventral surface; continuous low-intensity solid banding along the trailing edges and terminal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and deep valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the lighter background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a broad upward convexity on the leading edges and a variable trajectory on the trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions detected, including diagonal rake marks on the left lobe and vertical scratches near the lower peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of circular scarring and multiple distinct linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high density of well-defined annular scar patterns across the central white field.
